rationale: The bundle sha256 is well-formed (64 lowercase hex) but is the SHA-256 of the empty byte string. The snapshot file is nonempty, so the digest cannot match. The clarifications say digest mismatch gives code 2 with finding_id snapshot_tampered, verified before JSON decoding or comparison. evidence_audit_input_invalid is not added because the clarification names a single ID. The snapshot and claim are otherwise a consistent clean receipt, so a mutant that skips or mis-compares the digest returns 0/evidence_audit_clean.
